headline: Malawi brewer Castel faces 100 job cuts as union seeks help | Nyasa Times
summary: Castel Malawi, the country's second-largest taxpayer, is on the verge of retrenching 100 employees, citing a challenging business operating environment.
why: Castel is a large international brewing group, and its Malawi unit is a significant local taxpayer and employer. Job cuts at major taxpayers can signal wider pressure on the business climate.
